mike.partnerships: Quick draft — lightweight SEV routing blueprint for Catalyst Cloud (marketplace) + Catalyst Hardware integrator. Goal: 10-min routing to partner oncall, shared war room, and automatic fallback to Redwood Dedicated. PTAL :eyes:

anna.devex: Nice, love lightweight. Can we keep shared-channel naming predictable? e.g. `#partner-catalyst-sev` and `#partner-catalyst-postmortem`?

sara.sre: Add the SRE oncall as fallback with `@sre_oncall` mention and include the runbook link. Also set severity tagging in channel topic.

tian.eng: Ops notes — suggest automated bridge creation via `ops_bot` when SEV >= P2. Example bot trigger:
```
/ops_bot create-warroom partner=catalyst sev=P1 channel=#partner-catalyst-sev
```
This posts join links and pins runbook.

mike.partnerships: Proposal for routing policy:
- P1: immediate SMS + Slack page to partner_oncall & Redwood SRE, auto-warroom
- P2: Slack DM to partner_oncall within 10m, escalate to SRE after 20m
- P3: Email to partner escalation alias, auto-ticket

sara.sre: Add health-checks for marketplace provisioning path (token exchange, model pull). If model pull fails >3x, escalate as P2.

catalyst_oncall: @mike.partnerships this looks good. For Catalyst we require a minimum 30-min joint war room for P1s and an ops liaison in channel. We can accept Slack shared channel + PagerDuty integration.

anna.devex: I'll draft a short checklist to pin in channel. Suggested fields: Impact, Start time, Partners oncall, Root contact, Mitigation steps, Rollback flags.

ops_bot: ACTION: warroom created: #partner-catalyst-sev (opener: mike.partnerships). Pinned: https://redwood/runbooks/partner-catalyst-sev

tian.eng: small config YAML for pager routing we can commit to infra repo:
```
partner: catalyst
routes:
  P1: [catalyst_pd_escalation, redwood_sre_pd]
  P2: [catalyst_pd_oncall]
  P3: [catalyst_escalation_email]
fallback: redwood_dedicated_pool
```

mike.partnerships: Next steps: anna to create pinned checklist and channel topic template; sara to add runbook test (simulate model pull fail); tian to open PR with routing YAML. We'll run a DR drill next Tuesday. :calendar:

catalyst_oncall: We'll standby for DR drill invite. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
